name: Tun Mutahir
bio: A recommendation from Mutahir can bring a trader’s complaint before the court. Those who rely on his hearing may find nobody willing to honor his promises after the purge.
notes: fact: Brown describes the Bendahara’s business and the execution ordered by Mahmud; Pires also records the purge but emphasizes the failed 1509 attack’s aftermath, fear and confiscation (Brown ch. XXII, pp. 159–164; Pires II, pp. 257–259)
gameplay: Individual cargo hearings and promises are invented; the competing explanations are not fixed private motives (people-factions.md §§2–3)
